title: Umugenzi Yahindukiye .
intro: Ugiye guhishura inkuru y’umutima wabaye mu gitutu c’ubuhanuzi yamara uhisemwo inzira ijana mu guhona. Uwo mubare yari asangiye inzu n’umwe mu ntumwa zatowe na Allah ariko ntiyatsindwa mu kigeragezo c’ukwizera. None uwo mugenzi yazimiye ni nde?
clues: Nabaye mu bantu banse umuhamagaro wo kugororoka, kandi sinabarwanya.
Narongowe n’umuhanuzi wa Allah, ariko sinari dusangiye ukwemera.
Igihe intumwa zaza iwanje zifise imburi, sinazizeye.
Uwo twubakanye yategetswe kuva mu gisagara ari kumwe n’abizera, nanje ntari muri bo.
Igihano caramanukiye abantu banje, nanje ndatikizwa kumwe na bo.
Nvugwa muri Korowani nk’akarorero k’ukutemera, iruhande y’umugore wa Nuh, muri Sura At-Tahrim.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Yasenga ibigirwamana ku mugaragaro muri Kaaba .
Yateguye umugambi wo kurwanya ubutumwa bw’umugabo wiwe

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Bajanwa mu bunyagano mu gihugu ca kure .

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
